coaching.headline: A favored offlane read became an 18/7 Revenant — ten of the offlane's eleven deaths were to him, and every late fall priced out a major.
coaching.team: The film reads as one hero and one habit: Revenant ran the map to 18/7 and 52k damage because he kept getting the isolated one-on-ones his kit is built for — four of them clean solo catches — while the film flags two of us with no armor into his 53k physical. The habit was fighting split: their nine fight wins came against two- and three-man groups with a winning lane absent, and the 23.8 and 24.3 fights were opened a body or three down. We won one fight in thirty minutes; they cashed four of their nine.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 21.7 loss at their Fangtooth started the cascade the file prices out — Fangtooth at 22, Primal Fangtooth at 27, Orb Prime at 29, each landing within a minute of our deaths.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 did the tank job — 40,555 mitigated and 19 wards — but the macro flags him more than anyone this game: at 14, 20, 23.8, 28.7 and 29.7 he was alive and ahead in the support matchup while a short-handed fight was lost across the map. Winning the lane is the license to leave it; five flagged no-shows is the drill.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's Zinx won the carry lane early exactly as read and kept farming through the flip, and the later flags treat him as pinned rather than absent — so the note is itemization, not effort: the film flags him with no armor into a Revenant who finished with 53k physical.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Feng Mao beat Revenant three times in skirmishes — at 2.9, 18.7 and 24.7 — and placed 6 wards, but the deaths at 14 and 22 preceded the lost Mini Prime and Fangtooth, and at 26.2 he was ahead in the jungle while a 0-3 went down at their Primal pit. Feng Mao's spellshield trades want teammates behind them; the two-man fights into Revenant at 14 and 20 were his one-on-one, not ours.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult
ourKits.winCondition: land long-range snipes on marked targets and reset on takedowns
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds a target in his sniper line
ourKits.playAgainst: close the gap — he's weak point-blank; dodge the skillshot snipe

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
ourKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
ourKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
ourKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

ourKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
ourKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
ourKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,754 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Revenant offlane players this patch (38% of the team's). The damage came from Imperator, Draconum, Pacifier.
Reckoning at rank 3: 110s base, about 95.7s by the end (13% shorter) from 15 ability haste: Draconum 15.
21 takedowns (18 kills, 3 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow).
Revenant dealt 52,620 hero damage, 38% of their team's, with +277 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Demolisher ignores 25%; against Terra (level 15: about 203 physical armor, 141 after penetration; took 33,103 physical damage from heroes, 87% of all hero damage they took) and Wraith (level 17: about 103 physical armor, 66 after penetration; took 15,401 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) that is about 26% and 23% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Hellfire Blast (augment): Helllfire Rounds' Fourth Shot deals 7% more damage and ignores 30% Bonus Physical Armor.

Sustain: 22% lifesteal; Terminus: On Overhealing from Lifesteal: Convert excess Healing into a Shield. Max Shield size: (+100%). The Shield slowly decays 15s after leaving combat.; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; 2,162 healing recorded.
Toughness: +40 physical armor; took 28,828 damage, mitigated 17,607, died 7 times.

Lesson: Revenant's penetration cut through: Terra took about 26% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 their armor was about 203, about 141 after 12 flat + 25% penetration).

(game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.5% in 80 games, 72% of picks, above the hero-role's 51.4%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Draconum, Pacifier.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Demolisher, Vermis.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Terra, Steel). Anti-heal on Terra. We killed Revenant 7 times.
Copy it? Too few Revenant offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

members.text: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

stacks.text: 3 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Draconum, Pacifier.

stacks.title: Every basic attack set off

members.name: Demolisher
members.text: Additionally, your Basic Attacks and Critical Strikes ignore 30% of Bonus Physical Armor.

members.name: Vermis
members.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Demolisher, Vermis.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.

countered.text: 2 of the 5 players Revenant killed built physical armor (Terra, Steel).

copy.text: Too few Revenant offlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

loadout.name: Tiny Titan
loadout.text: Behemoth shrinks Rampage instead, granting him 25/27.5/30% Total Attack Speed, but he receives 45% more damage.

ability.name: Behemoth
ability.what: Become enraged, growing in size and altering Rampage's abilities for 10s.

loadout.plain: Behemoth makes you smaller and much faster attacking instead of bigger, but you take a lot more damage while it lasts. Turns your ultimate into a damage window for chasing and finishing, not a tanking window.

loadout.name: Krix
loadout.text: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) increased Maximum Health, and bonus size equal to 0.5% of your Maximum Health.
loadout.plain: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness, and it makes Behemoth's healing and your passive regeneration worth more since both scale with max health.

loadout.name: Regenerative Tissue
loadout.text: After 8s without taking Hero damage, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per second at Levels 1/6/11/16.
loadout.plain: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Stacks with King of the Jungle's regeneration so you clear camps and reset between ganks without going back.

loadout.name: Predator
loadout.text: Camp Leader kills grant 10% Bonus Damage and 4% Movement Speed for 20s, with 100% bonus duration for Epic Monsters.
loadout.plain: Killing a camp leader gives a short burst of damage and move speed. Take a buff camp right before you gank so you arrive faster and hit harder.

loadout.name: Saphir's Mantle
loadout.text: Atlas:  Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Grow and gain max health for a few seconds while damaging heroes near you, then keep some health permanently. Pop it as you Pounce in to soak damage and grow tankier every fight.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 30 minutes, fewer deaths than about 89% of Rampage jungle players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Behemoth at rank 3: 110s base, about 84.6s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Basilisk 20, Void Helm 10.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Rampage dealt 25,695 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +40 physical power from items.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Cursed Scroll (item): On Basic Attack: Deal 20 (+3.5%) Damage to yourself and the Enemy Target. This damage cannot hurt you below 35% Health.

Saphir's Mantle (crest): Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
Predator (Eternal minor): Camp Leader kills grant 10% Bonus Damage and 4% Movement Speed for 20s, with 100% bonus duration for Epic Monsters.
Tiny Titan (augment): Behemoth shrinks Rampage instead, granting him 25/27.5/30% Total Attack Speed, but he receives 45% more damage.
Sustain: 7% omnivamp; Void Helm: Heal 20% more from all sources.; 33,190 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1180 health, +48 physical armor, +80 magical armor; took 65,977 damage, mitigated 60,473, died 1 times.

Loadout augment Tiny Titan: Behemoth makes you smaller and much faster attacking instead of bigger, but you take a lot more damage while it lasts. Turns your ultimate into a damage window for chasing and finishing, not a tanking window. (game text: Behemoth shrinks Rampage instead, granting him 25/27.5/30% Total Attack Speed, but he receives 45% more damage.) (changes Behemoth, 84.6s cooldown with their haste) Field: 52.6% in 1170 games, 54% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.4%.

Loadout Eternal Krix: More max health and a bigger body. Plain tankiness, and it makes Behemoth's healing and your passive regeneration worth more since both scale with max health. (game text: Gain 5% (+1% per Level) increased Maximum Health, and bonus size equal to 0.5% of your Maximum Health.) Field: 51.2% in 1807 games, 83% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.4%.

Loadout minor Regenerative Tissue: Heal a share of max health after a few seconds away from hero damage. Stacks with King of the Jungle's regeneration so you clear camps and reset between ganks without going back. (game text: After 8s without taking Hero damage, regenerate 0.2/0.4/0.7/1% Max Health per second at Levels 1/6/11/16.) Field: 51.9% in 1363 games, 75% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.4%.

Loadout minor Predator: Killing a camp leader gives a short burst of damage and move speed. Take a buff camp right before you gank so you arrive faster and hit harder. (game text: Camp Leader kills grant 10% Bonus Damage and 4% Movement Speed for 20s, with 100% bonus duration for Epic Monsters.) Field: 49.7% in 1001 games, 55% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.4%.

Loadout crest Saphir's Mantle: Grow and gain max health for a few seconds while damaging heroes near you, then keep some health permanently. Pop it as you Pounce in to soak damage and grow tankier every fight. (game text: Atlas:  Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.) Field: 52.3% in 1194 games, 55% of picks, above the hero-role's 50.4%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Cursed Scroll.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Rapture, Void Helm.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Rampage killed built physical armor (Steel, Terra). Anti-heal on Terra. We killed Rampage 1 time.
Copy it? Krix (Regenerative Tissue + Predator): 49.4% in 817 Rampage jungle games, below the hero's 50.4%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
